tips.aesyltips.real_01: The Sorting asks seven questions; the House with the highest affinity decides your fate.
tips.aesyltips.real_02: The House you receive is permanent. Changing House requires completing the Rite of Renunciation.
tips.aesyltips.real_03: Without a House, no spell works outside the Training Grounds.
tips.aesyltips.real_04: Aesyl has no newcomer protection. Train in the Training Grounds, where PvP is off.
tips.aesyltips.real_05: Combat skills are bought with Aureo in the Commercial District.
tips.aesyltips.real_06: The Tower has 1,000 floors, split into 50 blocks of 20.
tips.aesyltips.real_07: You can only advance in the Tower after clearing the current floor.
tips.aesyltips.real_08: From floor 30 of the Tower onward, PvP is on. Be wary of who climbs with you.
tips.aesyltips.real_09: When you die, your items drop where you fell and stay protected for you for about two minutes. Aureo is never lost.
tips.aesyltips.real_10: Each House has a representative who offers Favors only to its own. Each Favor is unique and can be done once per season.
tips.aesyltips.real_11: Only one Favor or Tower contract can be active at a time. Abandoning is free, but progress resets.
tips.aesyltips.real_12: In the Contention, the clan holding the most members in the area for 5 straight minutes wins.
tips.aesyltips.real_13: The Gladiator is a weekly event between clans. The winning clan takes the prize to its clan bank.
tips.aesyltips.real_14: In Fight!, participants are drawn into duels and the loser is eliminated, until one champion remains.
tips.aesyltips.real_15: In a duel, the wager is only charged once the challenge is accepted, and dying does not drop your items.
tips.aesyltips.real_16: Low karma changes how you are identified and can put a bounty on your head.
tips.aesyltips.lore_01: The Tower simply exists. No one knows if it has a last floor.
tips.aesyltips.lore_02: Some climb seeking glory. Others descend seeking answers. Many never return.
tips.aesyltips.lore_03: Auremark began as a camp at the foot of the Tower, shelter for those who left and the few who returned.
tips.aesyltips.lore_04: In Auremark, power is not inherited: it is earned, defended and, often, taken.
tips.aesyltips.lore_05: No one can say who truly rules Auremark. Influence and control are different things.
tips.aesyltips.lore_06: The magic of Aesyl is born of the Tower. Its effects are known; its nature remains a mystery.
tips.aesyltips.lore_07: Eight Houses, eight legacies. And a secret that perhaps should never be found.
tips.aesyltips.lore_08: In Aesyl there are no prophecies and no chosen heroes. Only those who dare to advance.
tips.aesyltips.lore_09: Where the known world ends, rises that which no one has ever understood.
tips.aesyltips.lore_10: The names that remain are those of whoever kept climbing when nothing was promised.
